test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Study the following arrangement and answer the question given below. All numbers given below are 2 digit numbers.

18 @ 61 # 22 63 76 $ 42 48 % 29 94 ϕ 56 27 75

If all the symbols are dropped from the series, what will be the product of the numbers which are third from the right end and fourth from the left end?
solution:
Given terms: 18 @ 61 # 22 63 76 $ 42 48 % 29 94 ϕ 56 27 75

If all the symbols are dropped from the series then the arrangements are:

18 61 22 63 76 42 48 29 94 56 27 75

Here,

Third from the right end is: 56,

Fourth from the left end is: 63,

And, product of number '56 and 63' are:

→ 56 × 63 = 3528.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
